name: @sandrobuilds/ghst
description: AI-aware pre-push leak protection for developers using Claude and Cursor

scripts.build: esbuild src/*.ts src/**/*.ts --platform=node --target=node18 --outdir=dist --format=esm && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const f='dist/index.js'; fs.writeFileSync(f, '#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f, 'utf8')); fs.chmodSync(f, 0o755);"

author: Sandro
